title: Braid group invariance of quantum tori and applications
summary: We establish that the skew-symmetric bicharacter on the group of $\ell$-weights of a quantum affine algebra is invariant under Chari's braid group action. Furthermore, we define an extension of this bicharacter to the group generated by prefundamental $\ell$-weights and show that this invariance continues to hold under the extended braid group action of Frenkel-Hernandez.
